subject: Post-demo: Identity access verification & next steps
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Lina Armstrong <lina.armstrong@healthway.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 30 May 2026 14:10:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo: Identity access verification & next steps

Hi Lina —

Thanks again for taking the call earlier today. Quick recap and the actions we discussed so your security and procurement teams have what they need to move forward: 

- SOC 2 / compliance: you asked about our current posture and timeline for the next audit. We confirmed we have SOC 2 Type I completed and Type II in progress (details below).
- GDPR/HIPAA: note we support data residency options and can sign a BAA where applicable.
- Identity & Access: primary asks were SAML SSO (IdP metadata), SCIM provisioning for user lifecycle, and RBAC/admin separation for tenant admins.

Next steps (proposed):
1) I’ll send an intake checklist that captures the SAML metadata you’ll provide and the list of admin accounts for RBAC mapping.
2) Please have your procurement team forward any vendor security questionnaire (you mentioned a spreadsheet) — we can start filling the parts that are standard and mark items that need evidence.
3) We’ll schedule a short follow-up (30 min) for SSO/SCIM technical handoff once you’ve sent metadata.

I attached a short security snapshot and the intake checklist to speed things up. If you prefer, Neha (CC’d) can take point on the SOC and evidence pieces.

Attachments: id-access-intake-checklist.xlsx (stub), redwood-security-snapshot.pdf (stub)

Thanks — talk soon.

— Priyom
Priyom Das
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Lina Armstrong <lina.armstrong@healthway.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Cc: Healthway Procurement <procure@healthway.com>
Date: Sun, 31 May 2026 09:42:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Post-demo: Identity access verification & next steps

Thanks, Priyom — appreciate the clear recap. A few quick clarifications from our side before we kickoff the checklist: 

1) SOC 2: do you have a target for Type II? We need to show a timeline to our security team and (separately) to our legal/BAA reviewers.
2) For HIPAA: are you already offering a standard BAA or is that an enterprise add-on?
3) SCIM mapping: our identity team uses Azure AD. Are there any known gaps with Azure AD SCIM v2?

Procurement attached the vendor questionnaire as an initial sheet — I’m forwarding it here. If you can populate the common fields, that will speed things up.

Procurement (CC) — can you confirm the procurement timeline on your end? We’re aiming to close vendor review by mid-June if possible.

Best,
Lina
Director, IT Security
Healthway Medical Systems

Attachment (from Healthway): healthway-security-questionnaire.xlsx (stub)

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Lina Armstrong <lina.armstrong@healthway.com>, Healthway Procurement <procure@healthway.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 01 Jun 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo: Identity access verification & next steps

Hi Lina + team —

Thanks for the questions. Quick answers and what we need from you to make the intake straightforward: 

SOC 2: Redwood has SOC 2 Type I as of March 2026; Type II audit is scheduled for Q4 2026 and the report will be available to customers under NDA shortly after completion. We can provide our current control matrix and the SOC 2 Type I letter now.

BAA: We support HIPAA-covered workflows and offer a standard BAA for customers that require it (enterprise addendum; can be included in the contract).

SCIM / Azure AD: We support SCIM v2 and have multiple customers on Azure AD. Typical mapping covers: userName, givenName, familyName, emails, active, externalId. If you have custom attributes, send an example mapping and we’ll confirm.

RBAC / Admins: Our platform distinguishes tenant owners vs. service admins. We can map role names to your internal titles; please provide a short list of admin emails and preferred role assignments.

What we’re attaching: the intake checklist (blank) — please fill the SAML metadata and admin list sections first. We can also take a pass on the Healthway questionnaire and return a redlined version for any items that require evidence.

Deliverables we’ll provide back: 
- Preliminary answers to the vendor questionnaire (within 3 business days of receiving it)
- IdP/SCIM integration runbook (technical guide)
- SOC 2 Type I letter + control matrix (upon NDA)

Suggested timeline:
- Tue 6/2: Healthway sends SAML metadata + admin list + questionnaire (if you want us to start filling).
- Wed 6/3: Redwood returns populated questionnaire draft + requested artifacts (or asks follow-ups).
- Within a week: schedule the technical handoff session for SSO/SCIM.

Attachments: id-access-intake-checklist.xlsx (stub)

Thanks — Neha
Neha Kapoor
Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference
neha.k@redwood.com

From: Lina Armstrong <lina.armstrong@healthway.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Cc: Healthway Procurement <procure@healthway.com>
Date: Tue, 02 Jun 2026 09:22:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Post-demo: Identity access verification & next steps

Neha — thanks, that helps a lot. I’ve looped in Tom from procurement and we’ll aim to get the metadata + admin list to you by EOD Tuesday (6/2).

Two follow-ups for your team: 
- Please confirm whether Redwood provides any pre-built Azure AD application manifest or connector we can deploy; that will save our IAM team some time.
- For the SOC 2 Type II timeline: our security committee wants a firm month (we can accept Q4 but prefer a target month). Is November 2026 reasonable?

I’m happy to book the 30-minute technical session after we send the metadata — can Priyom propose 2–3 slots?
